Description: Create board named PlayZone Store - Sprint 1 with Backlog / To Do, In Progress, Testing / Code Review, Done.
Acceptance Criteria: Board exists; sprint cards have owners, reviewers, priorities, and acceptance checks.

Card Name: Create SQL database and EF configuration
Description: Configure SQL Server connection and StoreDbContext.
Acceptance Criteria: EF Core SQL Server provider is configured; local connection uses no production credentials; initial migration is committed.

Description: Add identity-backed User and Role models.
Acceptance Criteria: User and Role use secure ASP.NET Core Identity storage; email is unique; no plaintext password field exists.

Description: Add product catalog data and category relationships.
Acceptance Criteria: Product has SKU, name, description, price, active flag, and non-negative stock; category name and SKU are unique; product belongs to a category.

Description: Model order header and immutable item price snapshots.
Acceptance Criteria: Order belongs to a user and includes status, totals, and timestamps; each item stores product, positive quantity, and unit price at purchase.

Description: Add product reviews and configurable promotion rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Review belongs to a user and product with rating 1-5; promo code has type, value, active dates, minimum basket, and optional usage limit.

Card Name: Configure repository CRUD for all entities
Description: Wire the generic EF repository for User, Role, Product, Category, Order, OrderItem, Review, and PromoCode.
Acceptance Criteria: Get all, get by ID, add, update, and delete are available through EF for every entity; missing records are reported.

Description: Validate catalog, order, review, promo, and cart input at model and business layers.
Acceptance Criteria: Required names and identifiers, valid price, stock >= 0, positive order quantities, rating 1-5, and valid discount values are checked.

Description: Support percentage and fixed discounts with date, active, minimum basket, and redemption limit rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid promotions are rejected; discounts round to cents and cannot exceed subtotal.

Description: Add, change quantity, remove, clear, and calculate basket subtotal.
Acceptance Criteria: Only active products and positive quantities can be added; cart displays line totals; checkout revalidates product and stock.

Description: Create order and items, apply promo, decrement stock, and persist as one transaction.
Acceptance Criteria: Checkout rejects invalid users/products and insufficient stock; success snapshots prices and decrements stock; concurrency conflicts roll back.

Description: Specify catalog, product detail, cart, and checkout states; align forms with back-end contracts.
Acceptance Criteria: A compact flow and field/validation handoff is agreed before feature views are built.

Description: Create feature views/controllers for catalog, cart, and order checkout using agreed service contracts.
Acceptance Criteria: Views collect valid inputs and show validation/cart/order feedback; no business rules are duplicated in views.

Description: Create a QA matrix for CRUD, validation, discounts, cart, stock, and checkout scenarios.
Acceptance Criteria: Each required behavior has a positive and negative case with expected result and evidence field.

Description: Review/merge sprint work and attach the repository link in Classroom.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved work is on main; board reflects completion; each team member submits the repository URL; open issues are recorded.
